units.source_text: 因此，这一带的铺子尽管保留着红格子门和二楼小格子窗这样一些古色古香的京都风格，

en.t: Thus, although the shops in this area preserve such old-fashioned Kyoto features as red lattice doors and small lattice windows on the second floor,

units.source_text: 但实际上还不到百年历史。

en.t: in fact they are not even a hundred years old.

units.source_text: 据说，太吉郎店铺后面的仓库，幸免于这场战火的洗劫……

en.t: It is said that the storehouse behind Taikichiro's shop escaped the ravages of that wartime fire...
